summary: Use the JavaScript object model for iteration methods when generic receivers, Proxies, indexed accessors, or indexed prototype properties are observable.

target.notes: Execute the selected intrinsic Array iteration algorithm using ToObject/LengthOfArrayLike plus ordinary HasProperty/Get/Call semantics as required by that method. Preserve Proxy traps, getters, inherited indexed properties, generic array-like receivers, exceptions, and mutation ordering. Custom Array @@species for map/filter remains owned by array.custom-species.runtime.

caveats: Do not substitute Dictionary/List lookup for HasProperty/Get: prototype traversal and Proxy traps are observable.
Method-specific hole behavior still applies: the find family Gets every index, while most other iteration methods first test property presence.

tests.name: borrowed map works on an array-like object
proxy has and get traps are observable
tests.input: const log=[]; const p=new Proxy([7],{has(t,k){if(k==='0')log.push('has');return Reflect.has(t,k)},get(t,k,r){if(k==='0')log.push('get');return Reflect.get(t,k,r)}}); p.forEach(()=>{}); console.log(log.join(','));
